# Coin agent pack 0.1.78+18 (pilot)

> Machine-readable guidance for Coin, the Jio Finance design system's React Native components (jfs-components 0.1.78). Generated from the Coin designer guides and the installed package. Every rule cites the guide sentence it came from; every fact has a source.

Read rules.md first. Use this pack only with jfs-components 0.1.78.

## Pack

- [rules.md](rules.md): how to build with Coin, how to read this pack, and the exports it does not cover.
- [index.json](index.json): every entry's id, category, tags, state, summary and useInstead targets.
- [manifest.json](manifest.json): versions, build time, and entry counts by state.
- [graph.json](graph.json): how the components relate (useInstead, placedIn, slotAccepts, usedWith).
- [sizes.json](sizes.json): every file's size in bytes and tokens.

## Components

- [Button](components/button.md): Use Button when one clear action moves someone forward, confirms a choice, or completes a task. (flagged; brief: components/button.brief.md; links: components/button.links.md)
- [TextInput](components/textinput.md): Use a Text Input for a single line of text, such as a search, with an icon that hints at what to type. (flagged; brief: components/textinput.brief.md; links: components/textinput.links.md)
- [Badge](components/badge.md): Use a Badge to make a short status, category, or count easy to scan beside the content it describes. (flagged; brief: components/badge.brief.md; links: components/badge.links.md)
- [Accordion](components/accordion.md): Reveal supporting details when people need them, while keeping the page easy to scan. (flagged; brief: components/accordion.brief.md; links: components/accordion.links.md)
- [Stack](components/stack.md): Use Stack when a public component slot needs one token-driven gap and an intentional vertical or horizontal direction. (flagged; brief: components/stack.brief.md; links: components/stack.links.md)
- [BenefitCard](components/benefitcard.md): Use a Benefit Card to list what a plan or offer gives, with an optional upsell and one button to upgrade. (flagged; brief: components/benefitcard.brief.md; links: components/benefitcard.links.md)
- [VStack](components/vstack.md): Use VStack for page flow, grouped details, and ordered content. Its children follow token-driven spacing and padding while the host supplies the available height. (flagged; brief: components/vstack.brief.md; links: components/vstack.links.md)
- [HStack](components/hstack.md): Use HStack for a row of related content. It owns horizontal rhythm, alignment, and optional wrapping while the host decides how much room the row has. (flagged; brief: components/hstack.brief.md; links: components/hstack.links.md)
- [ButtonGroup](components/buttongroup.md): Keep a few related actions in one row with shared spacing and modes. (flagged; brief: components/buttongroup.brief.md; links: components/buttongroup.links.md)
- [IconButton](components/iconbutton.md): Use an Icon Button for a frequent, well-known action where an icon alone is clear, such as add, share, or close. (flagged; brief: components/iconbutton.brief.md; links: components/iconbutton.links.md)
- [Link](components/link.md): Use a Link to send people to related content, such as terms, help, or a recovery step, on its own line or inside a sentence. (flagged; brief: components/link.brief.md; links: components/link.links.md)
- [FormField](components/formfield.md): Use a Form Field to collect one labelled value, such as an account number, with a hint or an error message below it. (documented; brief: components/formfield.brief.md; links: components/formfield.links.md)
- [CheckboxItem](components/checkboxitem.md): Use Checkbox Item for a selectable row with a clear label and, when needed, a supporting action. (flagged; brief: components/checkboxitem.brief.md; links: components/checkboxitem.links.md)
- [Tabs](components/tabs.md): Use Tabs to switch between a few peer views of the same content, such as an account’s overview, activity, and details. (documented; brief: components/tabs.brief.md; links: components/tabs.links.md)
- [TabItem](components/tabitem.md): Use a Tab Item inside Tabs for each view: a short label that turns black with a gold underline while its view is showing. (documented; brief: components/tabitem.brief.md; links: components/tabitem.links.md)
- [Nudge](components/nudge.md): Use a Nudge for a short suggestion with one action, such as splitting a payment, that sits within a screen’s content. (flagged; brief: components/nudge.brief.md; links: components/nudge.links.md)
- [AppBar](components/appbar.md): Keep page identity, navigation and a few relevant actions together at the top of a view. (flagged; brief: components/appbar.brief.md; links: components/appbar.links.md)
- [ActionFooter](components/actionfooter.md): Keep the next step close to the decision. (flagged; brief: components/actionfooter.brief.md; links: components/actionfooter.links.md)
- [Stepper](components/stepper.md): Use a Stepper to show where someone is in a process with several stages, such as KYC, and how each stage went. (documented; brief: components/stepper.brief.md; links: components/stepper.links.md)
- [Step](components/step.md): Use a Step for one stage of a process inside a Stepper, such as Verify PAN, with its number or outcome and a line of detail. (documented; brief: components/step.brief.md; links: components/step.links.md)
- [Slider](components/slider.md): Use a Slider to pick a value from a wide range by dragging, such as a monthly SIP amount or a loan tenure. (flagged; brief: components/slider.brief.md; links: components/slider.links.md)
- [CardAdvisory](components/cardadvisory.md): Use a Card Advisory to show one score with a sentence on what it means and, if it helps, one next step. (flagged; brief: components/cardadvisory.brief.md; links: components/cardadvisory.links.md)
- [PaymentFeedback](components/paymentfeedback.md): Use a Payment Feedback on the screen after a payment to show the amount, whether it went through, and its reference. (documented; brief: components/paymentfeedback.brief.md; links: components/paymentfeedback.links.md)
- [ModalSheet](components/modalsheet.md): Use a Modal Sheet for a task that slides up over the page, such as asking HelloJio, and goes away when it’s done. (flagged; brief: components/modalsheet.brief.md; links: components/modalsheet.links.md)
- [SuggestiveSearch](components/suggestivesearch.md): Use a Suggestive Search to let people type and pick one item from a known list, such as their bank, with matches shown as they type. (flagged; brief: components/suggestivesearch.brief.md; links: components/suggestivesearch.links.md)
- [PdpCcCard](components/pdpcccard.md): Use a PDP Card at the top of a product page: the product’s picture, name, two or three key facts, and one action. (flagged; brief: components/pdpcccard.brief.md; links: components/pdpcccard.links.md)
- [HoldingsCard](components/holdingscard.md): Use a Holdings Card for one loan offer or holding: its headline amount, its key terms, and a radio to choose it from a list. (flagged; brief: components/holdingscard.brief.md; links: components/holdingscard.links.md)
- [CardBankAccount](components/cardbankaccount.md): Use a Card Bank Account to summarise one linked bank account: the bank, a few facts such as the masked number, and one action. (flagged; brief: components/cardbankaccount.brief.md; links: components/cardbankaccount.links.md)
- [Overlay](components/overlay.md): Use an Overlay to dim the screen behind a dialog, sheet, or drawer, so attention goes to what sits above it. (documented; brief: components/overlay.brief.md; links: components/overlay.links.md)
- [TransactionDetails](components/transactiondetails.md): Use Transaction Details to list the facts of one payment as label and value pairs: its ID, the accounts, and how it was paid. (documented; brief: components/transactiondetails.brief.md; links: components/transactiondetails.links.md)
- [ExpandableCheckbox](components/expandablecheckbox.md): Use an Expandable Checkbox for one consent whose text is too long for a line, such as agreeing to share KYC details. (documented; brief: components/expandablecheckbox.brief.md; links: components/expandablecheckbox.links.md)
- [FormUpload](components/formupload.md): Use a Form Upload to collect photos, such as receipts or ID proof, with a label, previews, and a hint about what to add. (documented; brief: components/formupload.brief.md; links: components/formupload.links.md)
- [BrandChip](components/brandchip.md): Use Brand Chip to identify a linked brand or account with an avatar and a short label. (flagged; brief: components/brandchip.brief.md; links: components/brandchip.links.md)
- [NumberPagination](components/numberpagination.md): Use Number Pagination to show which slide of a short media carousel is in view, and to jump to another. (flagged; brief: components/numberpagination.brief.md; links: components/numberpagination.links.md)
- [TransactionStatus](components/transactionstatus.md): Use a Transaction Status for the state and date of one payment on one line, as at the foot of a Transaction Bubble. (flagged; brief: components/transactionstatus.brief.md; links: components/transactionstatus.links.md)
- [RechargeCard](components/rechargecard.md): Use a Recharge Card to show one prepaid plan: its price, validity, data, the apps it includes, and the action to buy it. (flagged; brief: components/rechargecard.brief.md; links: components/rechargecard.links.md)
- [AreaLineChart](components/arealinechart.md): Show a continuous trend and make series comparison legible. (documented; brief: components/arealinechart.brief.md; links: components/arealinechart.links.md)
- [AccountCard](components/accountcard.md): Use an Account Card for one linked account in a row of accounts, or as the tile that adds another. (flagged; brief: components/accountcard.brief.md; links: components/accountcard.links.md)
- [Tooltip](components/tooltip.md): Use a Tooltip to explain a term or icon in a short line that opens from an info button and closes with the next press. (flagged; brief: components/tooltip.brief.md; links: components/tooltip.links.md)
- [OTP](components/otp.md): Use OTP to enter a one-time verification code, one digit per slot, with an optional resend timer. (flagged; brief: components/otp.brief.md; links: components/otp.links.md)
- [DropdownInput](components/dropdowninput.md): Use a Dropdown Input in a form when people choose one option from a list of four or more. (documented; brief: components/dropdowninput.brief.md; links: components/dropdowninput.links.md)
- [Skeleton](components/skeleton.md): Use a Skeleton group to show the shape of content while it loads, so the screen doesn't jump when it arrives. (documented; brief: components/skeleton.brief.md; links: components/skeleton.links.md)
- [FullscreenModal](components/fullscreenmodal.md): Use a Fullscreen Modal for a focused, full-screen moment, such as an upgrade offer, with a hero, details, and one main action. (flagged; brief: components/fullscreenmodal.brief.md; links: components/fullscreenmodal.links.md)
- [DebitCard](components/debitcard.md): Use a Debit Card to show a card the user already holds: its bank, type, last four digits, cardholder, and expiry. (documented; brief: components/debitcard.brief.md; links: components/debitcard.links.md)
- [Card](components/card.md): Use a Card to group one product, offer, or article on a panel, with an optional logo, a picture, and a few lines of text. (flagged; brief: components/card.brief.md; links: components/card.links.md)
- [MessageField](components/messagefield.md): Use a Message Field for a few sentences of free text, such as feedback or a description of a problem. (flagged; brief: components/messagefield.brief.md; links: components/messagefield.links.md)
- [Dropdown](components/dropdown.md): Use a Dropdown as the floating panel for a short list of choices or actions that opens from a button or field. (flagged; brief: components/dropdown.brief.md; links: components/dropdown.links.md)
- [ActionTile](components/actiontile.md): A compact shortcut to one destination. (flagged; brief: components/actiontile.brief.md; links: components/actiontile.links.md)
- [ProfileCard](components/profilecard.md): Use a Profile Card to show who the user is on a dark panel: initials or a photo, a name, UPI handles, and account rows below. (flagged; brief: components/profilecard.brief.md; links: components/profilecard.links.md)
- [Breadcrumbs](components/breadcrumbs.md): Use Breadcrumbs when people need a compact path back through a hierarchy. The trail moves from the broadest ancestor to the current page. (flagged; brief: components/breadcrumbs.brief.md; links: components/breadcrumbs.links.md)
- [EmptyState](components/emptystate.md): Use an Empty State when a list or screen has nothing to show, to say why and offer one next step. (flagged; brief: components/emptystate.brief.md; links: components/emptystate.links.md)
- [ValueBackMetric](components/valuebackmetric.md): Use a Value Back Metric to show a rewards balance, such as JioPoints or cashback, with how to earn more and one next step. (flagged; brief: components/valuebackmetric.brief.md; links: components/valuebackmetric.links.md)
- [ProductOverview](components/productoverview.md): Use a Product Overview to introduce one product: its picture, a chip, its name, a line of trust, and two or three key facts. (flagged; brief: components/productoverview.brief.md; links: components/productoverview.links.md)
- [Balance](components/balance.md): Use a Balance to show one money amount, such as what someone owes or holds, in large type under a short title. (documented; brief: components/balance.brief.md; links: components/balance.links.md)
- [MerchantProfile](components/merchantprofile.md): Use a Merchant Profile at the top of a payment to show who is being paid: the merchant’s logo, registered name, and UPI ID. (documented; brief: components/merchantprofile.brief.md; links: components/merchantprofile.links.md)
- [ComparisonBar](components/comparisonbar.md): Use a Comparison Bar to collect the items people pick to compare, as pictures in slots, and let them start the comparison. (documented; brief: components/comparisonbar.brief.md; links: components/comparisonbar.links.md)
- [ListGroup](components/listgroup.md): Use a List Group to put related list rows under one label, such as a month of payments, with one style for every row. (flagged; brief: components/listgroup.brief.md; links: components/listgroup.links.md)
- [IconCapsule](components/iconcapsule.md): Use an Icon Capsule to show one icon in a coloured circle, such as the mark at the start of a list row or a status on a result screen. (flagged; brief: components/iconcapsule.brief.md; links: components/iconcapsule.links.md)
- [Form](components/form.md): Use a Form to stack related fields and show the errors your screen sends for each one, such as a bank account’s details. (flagged; brief: components/form.brief.md; links: components/form.links.md)
- [ThreadHero](components/threadhero.md): Use a Thread Hero at the top of a payment or chat thread to show who the other person is: their name, banking name, and number. (flagged; brief: components/threadhero.brief.md; links: components/threadhero.links.md)
- [SegmentedTrack](components/segmentedtrack.md): Use a Segmented Track to show how one whole splits into a few parts, such as a portfolio’s equity, debt, and cash. (flagged; brief: components/segmentedtrack.brief.md; links: components/segmentedtrack.links.md)
- [Toast](components/toast.md): Use a Toast to confirm something that just happened, such as a payment or a copy, in a short message that closes itself. (flagged; brief: components/toast.brief.md; links: components/toast.links.md)
- [CardFinancialCondition](components/cardfinancialcondition.md): Use a Card Financial Condition to show one coverage score with a short reading, a hint on what's missing, and one button. (flagged; brief: components/cardfinancialcondition.brief.md; links: components/cardfinancialcondition.links.md)
- [Drawer](components/drawer.md): Use a Drawer for a panel that peeks from the bottom of a screen and drags up to show more, such as recent transactions. (documented; brief: components/drawer.brief.md; links: components/drawer.links.md)
- [NoteInput](components/noteinput.md): Use a Note Input for a short, optional memo under an amount, such as “Rent for April”, that grows as people type. (documented; brief: components/noteinput.brief.md; links: components/noteinput.links.md)
- [Attached](components/attached.md): Add a subordinate signal to a main item without altering its footprint. (flagged; brief: components/attached.brief.md; links: components/attached.links.md)
- [PlanComparisonCard](components/plancomparisoncard.md): Use a Plan Comparison Card to compare two or three plans feature by feature, with the plan you recommend in gold. (flagged; brief: components/plancomparisoncard.brief.md; links: components/plancomparisoncard.links.md)
- [Disclaimer](components/disclaimer.md): Use a Disclaimer for one short legal line under an action, such as who provides a payment service. (flagged; brief: components/disclaimer.brief.md; links: components/disclaimer.links.md)
- [CheckboxGroup](components/checkboxgroup.md): Use a Checkbox Group to let people pick any number of related options, such as accounts to link. (documented; brief: components/checkboxgroup.brief.md; links: components/checkboxgroup.links.md)
- [Spinner](components/spinner.md): Use a Spinner to show that something is loading when you can't show its shape or say how long it will take. (documented; brief: components/spinner.brief.md; links: components/spinner.links.md)
- [CardFeedback](components/cardfeedback.md): Use a Card Feedback to show the result of an action in the page, such as a payment that went through or failed, with one next step. (documented; brief: components/cardfeedback.brief.md; links: components/cardfeedback.links.md)
- [SummaryTile](components/summarytile.md): Use a Summary Tile to head a dashboard block: a title with a confidence meter, one line about the block, and one action or a chevron. (flagged; brief: components/summarytile.brief.md; links: components/summarytile.links.md)
- [TransactionBubble](components/transactionbubble.md): Use a Transaction Bubble for one payment in a chat thread: who it was with, the amount, and its status, opening its details. (flagged; brief: components/transactionbubble.brief.md; links: components/transactionbubble.links.md)
- [CcCard](components/cccard.md): Use a CC Card to sell one credit card: who it’s for, its key benefits, an upsell, and the joining fee, with one action. (flagged; brief: components/cccard.brief.md; links: components/cccard.links.md)
- [Toggle](components/toggle.md): Use a Toggle to switch one setting on or off, with the change taking effect straight away. (documented; brief: components/toggle.brief.md; links: components/toggle.links.md)
- [Avatar](components/avatar.md): Represent one person or account with an image or initials. (flagged; brief: components/avatar.brief.md; links: components/avatar.links.md)
- [TestimonialsCard](components/testimonialscard.md): Use a Testimonials Card for one customer quote, their initials or photo, their name, and their words, usually in a sideways row. (documented; brief: components/testimonialscard.brief.md; links: components/testimonialscard.links.md)
- [StatusHero](components/statushero.md): Use a Status Hero at the top of a result screen to confirm what just happened: a mark, the amount, a title, and one line. (flagged; brief: components/statushero.brief.md; links: components/statushero.links.md)
- [Table](components/table.md): Use a Table to compare a few values across rows, such as holdings, with columns that line up and numbers aligned right. (flagged; brief: components/table.brief.md; links: components/table.links.md)
- [HelloJioInput](components/hellojioinput.md): Use a HelloJio Input for the HelloJio assistant’s prompt: people type a question and send it, with optional attachments above. (documented; brief: components/hellojioinput.brief.md; links: components/hellojioinput.links.md)
- [ChipGroup](components/chipgroup.md): Use a Chip Group to lay out a row of Chip Select filters that wraps onto new lines with even gaps. (documented; brief: components/chipgroup.brief.md; links: components/chipgroup.links.md)
- [Checkbox](components/checkbox.md): Use Checkbox for an independent yes-or-no choice. People can select more than one option in a set. (flagged; brief: components/checkbox.brief.md; links: components/checkbox.links.md)
- [AmountInput](components/amountinput.md): Make monetary entry primary while keeping optional detail close. (flagged; brief: components/amountinput.brief.md; links: components/amountinput.links.md)
- [Popup](components/popup.md): Use a Popup for a short, focused moment, such as an offer or a reward, that slides up over the screen and asks for one choice. (documented; brief: components/popup.brief.md; links: components/popup.links.md)
- [AutoplayControl](components/autoplaycontrol.md): Let people pause and resume content that advances on its own, such as a slideshow. (flagged; brief: components/autoplaycontrol.brief.md; links: components/autoplaycontrol.links.md)
- [BottomNav](components/bottomnav.md): Use a Bottom Nav to move between the top-level sections of an app from any screen. (flagged; brief: components/bottomnav.brief.md; links: components/bottomnav.links.md)
- [UpiHandle](components/upihandle.md): Use a UPI Handle to show a UPI ID or number that people can recognise, copy, or scan, with an optional avatar. (documented; brief: components/upihandle.brief.md; links: components/upihandle.links.md)
- [FavoriteToggle](components/favoritetoggle.md): Use a Favorite Toggle on an image card so people can save the item for later with one tap. (flagged; brief: components/favoritetoggle.brief.md; links: components/favoritetoggle.links.md)
- [AccordionCheckbox](components/accordioncheckbox.md): Group related choices behind a clear heading. People can select the group and open its options independently. (flagged; brief: components/accordioncheckbox.brief.md; links: components/accordioncheckbox.links.md)
- [ChipSelect](components/chipselect.md): Use a Chip Select to show one filter, such as a date range, and whether it is applied. (flagged; brief: components/chipselect.brief.md; links: components/chipselect.links.md)
- [AvatarGroup](components/avatargroup.md): Show several people or identities as one compact visual cue. (flagged; brief: components/avatargroup.brief.md; links: components/avatargroup.links.md)
- [Screen](components/screen.md): Screen component that acts as the outer most container providing the background color. (Package docs; Coin has no designer guide for Screen.) (undocumented; brief: components/screen.brief.md; links: components/screen.links.md)
- [Text](components/text.md): Coin has no designer guide for Text; use its facts from the package types. (undocumented; brief: components/text.brief.md; links: components/text.links.md)
- [Title](components/title.md): Coin has no designer guide for Title; use its facts from the package types. (undocumented; brief: components/title.brief.md; links: components/title.links.md)
- [ListItem](components/listitem.md): ListItem component that mirrors the Figma "List Item" component. (Package docs; Coin has no designer guide for ListItem.) (undocumented; brief: components/listitem.brief.md; links: components/listitem.links.md)
- [Icon](components/icon.md): Icon component — a design-token-driven wrapper around a single glyph. (Package docs; Coin has no designer guide for Icon.) (undocumented; brief: components/icon.brief.md; links: components/icon.links.md)
- [Image](components/image.md): Coin has no designer guide for Image; use its facts from the package types. (undocumented; brief: components/image.brief.md; links: components/image.links.md)
- [Divider](components/divider.md): Divider component that renders a horizontal or vertical separator line. This component is used to visually separate content sections. (Package docs; Coin has no designer guide for Divider.) (undocumented; brief: components/divider.brief.md; links: components/divider.links.md)
